---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible Studio or visitor-runtime problem
title: ''
---

## Expected and actual behavior

Explain the publisher or visitor action, what should happen, and what happened.

## Reproduction

Provide minimal steps using a synthetic fixture. Include the commit, Node version, OS/browser, and demo or connected mode. Do not include credentials, original publisher documents or private logs.

## Evidence

Include a redacted error or screenshot if it helps. State which checks were run and whether model/storage responses were mocked.
